description: This file contains unit tests for the ManifestProvider class in the org.eclipse.ditto.services.utils.cluster package. It verifies behaviors such as immutability, exception handling, and the retrieval of manifest strings from various command and response objects.

classes.name: ManifestProviderTest
classes.description: Unit test class for ManifestProvider, testing its various behaviors including immutability, exception handling, and manifest retrieval.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the ManifestProvider instance before each test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that ManifestProvider class instances are immutable.

methods.name: tryToGetManifestForNull
methods.description: Verifies that calling apply() on null throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: getManifestFromCommandNotSupportedException
methods.description: Tests that a CommandNotSupportedException returns its error code as the manifest.

methods.name: getManifestFromThingCommand
methods.description: Verifies that retrieving manifest from a RetrieveThing command returns the command's type.

methods.name: getManifestFromThingCommandResponse
methods.description: Checks that retrieving manifest from a CreateThingResponse returns its type.
